request.subject_description: Exact source rabbit ninja: cream fur, ONE upright and ONE bent/folded ear, plum ninja jacket, dark pants, short red scarf, round tail, original waist gear and SHORT belt dagger. Preserve pixel identity, proportions, costume asymmetry and weapon hand.
request.initial_pose: Exact original north-west standing idle reference. Preserve one upright and one bent ear, the same short belt dagger and all original equipment.
request.action_description: ONE quick straight DAGGER THRUST and recovery. Target is UPPER LEFT / LEFT of the image. Keep the fixed BACK THREE-QUARTER NORTH-WEST: the back of head and jacket stay toward camera body axis in every frame; no body turn or spin. Begin from source idle. Lower chest and bend knees slightly, draw the short dagger close to the waist. Then sharply extend the dagger hand in ONE STRAIGHT LINE across the front toward the target: the blade must visibly project into the UPPER LEFT / LEFT of the image space outside the body silhouette, not stay on the opposite side. Brief full-extension pose, then retract arm to belt and recover to the exact source idle. It is a stab, not a sweeping slash. Feet remain planted and root stays fixed; forward travel is added by the game. Preserve one permanently bent ear and one upright ear at every angle, the same short dagger and hand, and source outfit. Blade length stays shorter than torso width; never a sword. BODY ONLY: transparent background, no slash trails, no particles, no flashes, no shockwaves, no duplicate bodies, no new equipment. Keep source pixel-art rendering and proportions.
